Title: Can Bitcoin Seal its Best Weekly Close in Over Three Months?

URL Source: https://cointelegraph.com/markets/bitcoin-preps-highest-weekly-close-since-january-as-btc-price-nears-79k

Published Time: Sun, 03 May 2026 18:20:14 GMT

Markdown Content:
Bitcoin (BTC) eyed $79,000 into Sunday’s weekly close as crypto markets continued to be guided by the US-Iran war.

**Key points:**

*   Bitcoin circles a key weekly level into the weekly close, with the highest close in several months on the table.
*   Analysis sees the mid-$80,000 zone and higher coming back into play.
*   Liquidity grabs form the basis for caution among some traders.

## BTC price nears highest weekly close in over three months

Data from TradingView showed BTC/USD attempting to hold higher after [cancelling out losses](https://cointelegraph.com/markets/bitcoin-seals-best-monthly-gain-in-a-year-as-sp-500-hits-fresh-all-time-high) from earlier in the week.

Finishing the week above $78,670 would deliver the pair’s highest weekly close since late January.

![Image 1](https://resizer.cointelegraph.com/cdn-cgi/image/f=auto,onerror=redirect,w=896,q=90/https://payload.cointelegraph.com/api/media/file/BTCUSD_2026-05-03_17-59-47.png?prefix=media%2Fcontent)
_BTC/USD one-week chart. Source: Cointelegraph/_[_TradingView_](https://www.tradingview.com/symbols/BTCUSD/)

Friday delivered a boost to risk assets as hopes of a fresh peace agreement between the US and Iran accelerated. On Sunday, however, US President Donald Trump appeared skeptical of ratifying Iran’s latest peace proposals.

In a post on [Truth Social](https://truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump/posts/116507414650995614), Trump wrote that he “can’t imagine that it would be acceptable.”

![Image 2](https://resizer.cointelegraph.com/cdn-cgi/image/f=auto,onerror=redirect,w=893,q=90/https://payload.cointelegraph.com/api/media/file/Screenshot%202026-05-03%20at%2017.38.38.png?prefix=media%2Fcontent)
_Source: Truth Social_

Despite this, some crypto market commentators remained optimistic about the short-term outlook.

“Strong consolidation on $BTC , and Friday gave us a slight insight in what's likely to come,” trader and analyst Michaël van de Poppe [wrote](https://x.com/CryptoMichNL/status/2050875512499704298) on X.

Van de Poppe referenced Friday’s strong inflows to the US spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs), which totaled nearly $630 million.

“I don't think this will slow down in the coming week and that's probably why we're seeing a relatively shallow consolidation taking place,” he continued.

> “The $79K area is a crucial zone. That needs to break. If this breaks, I'm assuming we'll see more upwards momentum and I've got $86-88K as first resistance area and $92-94K as the crucial one.”

![Image 3](https://resizer.cointelegraph.com/cdn-cgi/image/f=auto,onerror=redirect,w=896,q=90/https://payload.cointelegraph.com/api/media/file/HHW-lPlbYAAjuXu.jpeg?prefix=media%2Fcontent)
_BTC/USDT one-day chart. Source: Michaël van de Poppe/X_

## Bitcoin traders warn of liquidity games

Caution was also visible, with traders watching for liquidity grabs to the upside before a subsequent price reversal.

[_**Related: Here’s what happened in crypto today**_](https://cointelegraph.com/news/what-happened-in-crypto-today)

“Starting to see a build of liquidity form below, but a take of the high liquidity and using that to dump,” Crypto Tony [commented](https://x.com/CryptoTony__/status/2050852108878921758) on data from [CoinGlass](https://www.coinglass.com/pro/futures/LiquidationHeatMapNew) on the day.

![Image 4](https://resizer.cointelegraph.com/cdn-cgi/image/f=auto,onerror=redirect,w=896,q=90/https://payload.cointelegraph.com/api/media/file/_BTC%20Liquidation%20Heatmap(24%20hour)-2026-05-03_17_57_12.png?prefix=media%2Fcontent)
_BTC liquidation heatmap. Source: CoinGlass_

Trading account JDK Analysis described the liquidity setup as “typically bearish.”

“We can clearly see fresh longs opening into the highs, while price continues to show signs of absorption - unable to push meaningfully higher despite increasingly aggressive market buying for now,” it summarized in [posts on X](https://x.com/The_JDK99/status/2050909609766883680).

![Image 5](https://resizer.cointelegraph.com/cdn-cgi/image/f=auto,onerror=redirect,w=896,q=90/https://payload.cointelegraph.com/api/media/file/HHZKxnNXsAAvCIH.jpeg?prefix=media%2Fcontent)
_BTC/USDT 15-minute chart. Source: JDK Analysis/X_

It does not constitute investment advice or recommendations. All investments and trades carry risk; readers are encouraged to conduct independent research.

Title: Bitcoin Posts Strongest Monthly Gain In 12 months In April

URL Source: https://cointelegraph.com/news/bitcoin-posts-its-strongest-monthly-gain-in-12-months-in-april

Published Time: Sun, 03 May 2026 18:15:13 GMT

Markdown Content:
Bitcoin has posted its best-performing month in a year, prompting analysts to forecast what could lie ahead for May, which has historically delivered returns of about 8%.

“Long way to go back to ATHs, but good to see some green,” Coin Bureau founder Nic Puckrin [said](https://x.com/nicrypto/status/2050138508887740740?s=20) in an X post on Friday, referring to Bitcoin’s (BTC) performance during the month of April, which saw a monthly return of 11.87%.

It marked Bitcoin’s best-performing month since April 2025, when it returned 14.08%. However, it still came in slightly below its historical April average of 12.98%, [according](https://www.coinglass.com/today) to CoinGlass.

![Image 1](https://resizer.cointelegraph.com/cdn-cgi/image/f=auto,onerror=redirect,w=896,q=90/https://payload.cointelegraph.com/api/media/file/Screen%20Shot%202026-05-02%20at%201.55.55%20pm.png?prefix=media%2Fcontent)
_Bitcoin has historically delivered an average return of 7.78% in May. Source:_[_CoinGlass_](https://www.coinglass.com/today)

“April is done. May is here. After 5 consecutive red monthly candles, Bitcoin has now closed 2 in the green, causing some relief in the market,” crypto trader Daan Crypto Trades [said](https://x.com/DaanCrypto/status/2050100384341926337?s=20) in an X post on Friday.

## Market participants hold the belief that history repeats

Market participants often compare current monthly performance with previous months and look ahead, as many believe Bitcoin’s history tends to repeat itself.

Bitcoin is trading at $78,190, about 38% down from its October all-time high of $125,100, [according](https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/bitcoin/) to CoinMarketCap. Crypto analyst Jelle [said](https://x.com/CryptoJelleNL/status/2050501283975442687?s=20), “We hit the ground running again next week.”

![Image 2](https://resizer.cointelegraph.com/cdn-cgi/image/f=auto,onerror=redirect,w=896,q=90/https://payload.cointelegraph.com/api/media/file/Screen%20Shot%202026-05-02%20at%201.59.02%20pm.png?prefix=media%2Fcontent)
_Bitcoin started April at around $66,000. Source:_[_CoinMarketCap_](https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/bitcoin/)

Market participants appear uncertain about the crypto market, according to the Crypto Fear & Greed [Index](https://alternative.me/crypto/fear-and-greed-index/), which posted a “Fear” reading of 39 on Friday, suggesting investors are still cautious.

## Bitcoin analysts are divided on what comes next

Analysts are divided on Bitcoin’s near-term outlook. Crypto analytics firm [CryptoQuant warned that Bitcoin](https://cointelegraph.com/news/bitcoin-risks-decline-rally-speculative-not-structural-cryptoquant) could be setting up for a multi-month price decline after a rally in April driven mainly by futures traders.

_**Related:**_[_**Bitcoin rally extends, yet BTC options price only 25% chance of $84K in May**_](https://cointelegraph.com/markets/bitcoin-rally-extends-yet-btc-options-price-only-25-chance-of-84k-in-may)

Others are more bullish. MN Trading Capital founder [Michael van de Poppe](https://cointelegraph.com/news/bitcoin-doesnt-need-a-fresh-narrative-to-reclaim-100k-analyst) recently said that Bitcoin may not need a new story or catalyst to push back above the psychological $100,000 level, which it has not traded above in nearly five months.

“There doesn't need to be a narrative that pushes the price upwards,” van de Poppe [said](https://x.com/CryptoMichNL/status/2050115439611596886?s=20) in an X post on Friday, after asking, “What narrative will bring Bitcoin to $100K?”

The last time Bitcoin traded at $100,000 was Nov. 13, just a month after the Oct. 10 $19 billion crypto market liquidation event.

_**Magazine:**_[_**Why is Ethereum Foundation selling? BTC futures warning signs: Market Moves**_](https://cointelegraph-magazine.com/bitcoin-btc-price-futures-trump-memecoin-xrp-ethereum-trade-secrets/)

Cointelegraph is committed to independent, transparent journalism. This news article is produced in accordance with Cointelegraph’s [Editorial Policy](https://cointelegraph.com/editorial-policy) and aims to provide accurate and timely information. Readers are encouraged to verify information independently.
